channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about De'Anthony Melton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about De'Anthony Melton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on De'Anthony Melton
item.description:
Steve Kerr recently revealed the veteran guard still has a way to go before returning to the court for Golden Stateand making his season debut.

“Melton is with us on the trip and really putting in the work, starting to scrimmage and that kind of stuff,”

Steve Kerr on De'Anthony Melton, Nov 18, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Jordan Poole on De'Anthony Melton
item.description:
“If Melton is cleared, and from what I understand, he has been working out at Chase [Center], the word I was given by somebody who’s seen him is that he’s progressing well, but they don’t know when he’ll be fully cleared,”

Jordan Poole on De'Anthony Melton, Sep 28, 2025. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Stephen Curry on De'Anthony Melton
item.description:
“We have options, obviously. We have a defensive-minded guy like Melton. You got a guy who is kind of a connector, can put the ball on the floor (and) create like BP. Me and BP started a couple times last year. You got Buddy who can shoot (and) space the floor, a veteran who knows how to play.”

Stephen Curry on De'Anthony Melton, Oct 2, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Doc Rivers on De'Anthony Melton
item.description:
Doc Rivers on @De’Anthony Melton and his two-way impact on this @Philadelphia 76ers team:

“He’s been a savior. He’s been great for us… As good as we thought he was defensively, he’s been better. He has the ability to affect how guys play.”

Doc Rivers on De'Anthony Melton, Dec 2, 2022. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Danny Green, De'Anthony Melton
item.description:
“First and foremost, I want to thank Danny Green for everything he gave the Sixers organization over the last two seasons. He was a veteran leader, consummate professional on and off the court, and made us all better. I wish him continued success in his recovery and look forward to seeing him back on the court. Heading into the draft, we had a goal of strengthening our rotation and believe we accomplished that by acquiring De’Anthony Melton. He is a young, tough and talented two-way player who can impact the game on multiple levels. We think he will thrive here and we’re excited to add him to our roster,”

Daryl Morey on Danny Green, De'Anthony Melton, Jun 24, 2022. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Zach Kleiman on De'Anthony Melton
item.description:
Damichael Cole:Zach Kleiman:

“De’Anthony Melton was a big part of this team. Never easy to move on from someone who was a significant part of the team.”

Zach Kleiman on De'Anthony Melton, Jun 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @DamichaelC.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Gerald Green, James Ennis, De'Anthony Melton
item.description:
Mike D'Antoni:

“I think James Ennis can be really good. I think people are downplaying him. Gerald Green will take another step forward. The De'Anthony Melton kid looked really good... If we're going to beat Golden State...you gotta take some chances... I think the worst we're going to be is great.”

Mike D'Antoni on Gerald Green, James Ennis, De'Anthony Melton, Jul 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.
